en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a busy quay or harbor square lined with multi‑story European buildings. In the foreground many men, women, and children stand or work around barrels and carts on an open paved area. At the left are masts of moored boats and a small dockside office. Prominent building façades carry large advertisements and signs, including one for a café on a corner building. The lower margin is filled with handwritten cursive text in ink.
